subject: ISO27001 control sampling plan — pre-audit handoff and ask
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: AuditWorks <auditworks@auditors.com>, Julie Chen <julie.chen@acmepayments.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ISO27001 control sampling plan — pre-audit handoff and ask

Team —

AuditWorks will start the onsite/readiness dry run with Acme next week (kickoff Mon 2028-09-18). I put together a proposed control sampling approach and an evidence inventory snapshot for Acme (attached). Key asks before I share the final package with the auditor: 

- Confirm sampling population for identity/access (IAM) controls: user provisioning logs, role authorizations, and privileged access reviews. I proposed 30 samples across production and staging combined.
- Confirm retention window for log pulls (we've got 18 months in the inventory; Acme asked for 12 months).
- Identify owners for each evidence bucket so AuditWorks has a direct contact during dry run.

Attachments: redwood-iso27001-control-mapping-v3.xlsx, evidence-inventory-snapshot-20280914.csv, iso-scope-summary-acme.pdf

Proposed next steps: Kimberly to confirm sampling sizes by EOD Fri; David to validate log retention/query examples; Priya to assign evidence owners and update the links. I'll then share the final package with AuditWorks and Acme.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: AuditWorks <auditworks@auditors.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ISO27001 control sampling plan — pre-audit handoff and ask

Thanks Sofia — good packet. A few clarifications from my side: 

1) Sampling: 30 combined sounds reasonable but let's stratify: 20 from production (mix of web and API users) and 10 from staging/ops/admin access. That will help cover both operational and privileged profiles.
2) Retention: For log pulls, stick with 12 months for Acme's scope; internally we keep 18 months but send 12 months of indexed extracts to auditors.
3) Evidence owners: I'll take IAM role changes + privileged access review buckets.

I'll update the control-mapping sheet with the stratified sample plan and tag the rows I own. Expect updated xlsx by 13:00 PT.

-Kimberly
Director, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: AuditWorks <auditworks@auditors.com>

Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ISO27001 control sampling plan — pre-audit handoff and ask

Hi all,

Thanks for the advance packet. A couple of items we need clarified to scope our dry run evidence pulls: 

- Timeframe: confirm the exact 12-month window (e.g., 2027-09-01 through 2028-08-31) so our log ingestion aligns.
- Logs: for API gateway logs please include example query strings and a small sample export (we don't need full retention export in the pre-audit).
- Exceptions & compensating controls: if you have documented exceptions for IAM or network controls relevant to Acme's environment, include the RITM/approval IDs.

Also — can David provide a short list of the log tables and the field names we should expect? If you can post them to the Drive link you listed, that will speed the dry run.

Regards,
Michael Reynolds
Senior Auditor, AuditWorks

Appreciate the fast turnaround, everyone. Quick summary and actions: 

- Kimberly: updated sampling stratification in the attached xlsx (see column 'SamplePlan' and your tagged rows).
- David: noted the Drive uploads and timeframe — thanks for the RITM references, that's helpful.
- Priya: please add the primary evidence owners to the Drive folder and ping the AuditWorks lead with direct contact info.
- AuditWorks: we'll be ready for the dry run on Mon morning; if you want a 30-minute pre-call Sun evening to walk the folder, happy to schedule.

Julie — FYI from our side, we'll only provide 12 months of indexed log extracts to your audit team per the agreed scope. If Acme needs the longer internal retention view, we can discuss a separate request.

I'll package the final control-mapping and evidence-owner list and post it to the Drive by 19:00 PT.

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
